content: Kitembu kya Nzambi yi kitembu kya Mutendi
Baphangi batondama, lukwikilakaku mwena kosu kitembu; kaasi simbululakenu bitembu mu zayila yuka ni byenina bya Nzambi, mukuma bambikudi ba bukamvi lawu bamwangani mu tsi.
Tala buna lwazayila yuka ni Kitembu kya Nzambi wuna: kitembu kyosu kina kyatámbwasa ni Yesu Kidisitu kisa mu kimutu kyakina kyenina kya Nzambi.

Kaasi wosu wuna wubwisini mu kutambwasa Yesu bwosu buna kenina, yandi keku wa Nzambi, kaasi kenina kitembu kya Mutendi wa Kidisitu: lwáyuka ni wuna wáfwana mu kukwisa amana buthwena wekina kedi muna tsi.
Kaasi benu, bana bama, Nzambi wuluvwini amana phi lwábanunga bambikudi ba bukamvi; mukuma Wuna wenina mwena benu kenina wa mbuta kuhita wuna wenina mwena babana bavwini kwena tsi.
Batu meni babana, tsi yibavwini. Yihakana ni nzonzidi ya bawu yenina ya mutindu wa batu ba tsi amana tsi yisi bayukila.
Kaasi betu, Nzambi wutuvwini. Mutu wuna wumuzayini Nzambi kisi tuyukila; wuna kondi kala wa Nzambi kisiku tuyukila. Bwabuna twalenda zayila Kitembu wa kyedika yi kitembu kina kyisi totisa.
Nzambi kenina lungongu
Banduku bama batondama, tudizolenu betu yi betu, mukuma lungongu kwena Nzambi lwisi tuka. Wosu wuna wisi zola mukwenu, mwena Nzambi kábutukila amana phi wumuzayi Nzambi.
Wuna wisiku zola kábutukilaku mwena Nzambi, mukuma Nzambi kenina lungongu.
Tala Nzambi buna kásongila lungongu lwandi kikuma kya betu: Yandi wátuma Mwana wandi mosi muna tsi, mu twavwila luzingu lwa mwana Yandi
Amana lungongu meni lwaluna lwenina bwabu: heku ni betu twámuzola Nzambi, kaasi yandi wátuzola; wátuma Mwana wandi wuna wádilambula hanga kimenga kikuma kya ndoluka ya masumu metu
Banduku bama, yuka ni bwabuna kátuzodila Nzambi, tufweti dizola phi betu yi betu.
Heku mutu wámumona kedi Nzambi. Yuka ni twadizolaka betu yi betu, Nzambi kenina mwena betu, amana lungongu lwandi lwisi lungidila mwena betu
Muna bwabuna, tuzayi ni mwena yandi thwisi nangina, hanga yandi mwena betu: yandi wátuheka Kitembu wandi.
Amana betu, twámona amana tubati ta kimbangi ni Tata kámuhitika Mwana wandi hanga Muhuludi wa tsi
Wuna wisi tambwasa ni Yesu kenina Mwana wa Nzambi, Nzambi kisi nangina mwena yandi, bwosu yandi mwena Nzambi.

Amana betu, tuzayilwa lungongu luna kenina lwawu Nzambi kikuma kya betu, amana thwisi kwikila ni Nzambi kisi tuzola. Nzambi kenina lungongu; wuna wisi nangina mu lungongu, mwena Nzambi kisi nangina, amana Nzambi kisi nangina mwena yandi.
Yuka ni lungongu lwakala lwalungila mwena betu, hahana nana twakádila babasa yi kikumbwala muna kilumbu kya pfundusu; bwosu buna kenina Yandi, bwabuna thwenina betu phi mu tsi yayi.
Muna lungongu mwisiku kala yi bweya; lungongu lwa mukwandi lwisi katula bweya. Bweya bwádikasa yi kuhingila kwa ndola amana wuna wenina yi bweya keku walungila muna lungongu.
Kwena betu, thwisi zola, kikuma yandi wátekila tuzola mutu wa theti.
Yuka ni mutu kazonzaka: «Nzambi yisi muzola» amana kamengaka phangi wandi, kenina kingumba. Kikuma, yuka ni kisiku muzola phangi wandi yandi kisi mona, kalendaku muzola phi Nzambi wuna kisiku mona.
Amana tala mukuku kátuheka: wuna wisi zola Nzambi kafweti zola phi phangi wandi
